title: fix: improve call logs UI — proper caller display, forwarded calls & formatted numbers
body:
## Summary

Fixes the Phone module's call logs to show proper caller identification instead of "Unknown" for most entries.

**Caller display logic:**
```
if (contact in CRM) → contact name
else if (phone number available) → formatted as (XXX) XXX-XXXX
else → "Unknown Caller"
```

**Forwarded calls:** Detected via `event.status === "forwarded"` or `payload.ForwardedFrom` field. Shows the caller name/number with a purple "Forwarded" tag instead of displaying "Unknown".

**Changes to `app/crm/phone/page.tsx`:**
- Added `isForwardedCall(event)` — checks status and payload for forwarding indicators
- Added `formatPhoneDisplay(phone)` — formats US numbers as `(XXX) XXX-XXXX`
- Updated record building to use priority: contact name → formatted phone → "Unknown Caller"
- Added `tag` field to `CallRecord` for visual indicators
- UI shows colored tags: "Forwarded" (purple) and "Unknown Caller" (gray) next to caller name
- Secondary line shows consistently formatted phone number

No backend, database, Conversation Board, or business logic changes.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/7b6dcefc10124c5eac525050a143166f
